title: I love them so much I bought 2 sets as gifts.
text: I love them so much I bought 2 sets as gifts.. I've getting to the age where the baby boomers take meals to others, especially during covid. These withstand the heat of a microwave and  dishwasher, The cold of a freezer and refrigerator. They absolutely will not leak or spill in your car. They're great for traveling, or just keeping things fresh and from spilling. No fridge messes either. You won't regret this purchase. I bought a set for my Aunt and Sister too.

description: OXO Good Grips Smart Seal Airtight Food Storage Containers are made of BPA-free plastic, so they're ideal for storing leftovers or bringing a meal on the go. Four locking tabs and a removable silicone gasket work together to create a truly spillproof seal – for no leaks and no worries. Smart Seal Containers stack conveniently in your fridge, and neatly nest in your cabinet. Lids are interchangeable between glass and plastic Smart Seal Containers. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

From taking meals on the go to storing them for later, OXO Good Grips Smart Seal Glass Food Storage Containers are the smart way to keep food fresh. Four locking tabs and a removable silicone gasket work together to create a truly spillproof seal – for no leaks and no worries. Made from naturally BPA-free borosilicate glass, these durable containers are built to go from freezer to oven (or microwave!) without the need to fully thaw. Dishwasher safe and stainproof, Smart Seal Containers stack conveniently in your fridge or freezer, and neatly nest in your cabinet. The elegant design moves seamlessly between the kitchen to your table
